text:
maya: FYI I opened a tiny PR to clarify rate limit headers + add an SDK snippet for quota-aware retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7922

liam: Thanks. Quick question 12 are we standardizing on a single header name? I see X-Rate-Cap and X-RateLimit-Limit floating around.

maya: The plan in the PR is to introduce a canonical X-RW-Rate-Limit and keep the older names as aliases. Docs should show a fallback pattern for clients.

sanjay: Agreed on X-RW-Rate-Limit. Also propose we add a one-line migration note under "Breaking changes" that it's an alias, not a hard rename.

liam: I'll add the python + node snippets with fallback lookup and a unit test for the python SDK. Example idea: headers.get('X-RW-Rate-Limit') || headers.get('X-Rate-Cap') || headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit').

docs-bot: Link checker: detected broken dashboard URL in PR -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/oldpanel/rate-summary (404).

maya: Fixed in commit 9c3d 1 replaced link with https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/newpanel/usage-rates and added a one-sentence explanation of the "burst credits" metric.

product-ops: Please note burst credits are tracked per-customer-id (not per-api-key). Left suggested wording in the PR comment.

liam: Will include that wording in the migration guide section "Handling 429s & burst credits" and in the SDK retry README.

maya: Plan: finish docs review today, wait for liam's tests and one eng signoff, then merge and add a changelog entry under Rate limits & Quotas for release 1.12.

sanjay: Ping me after CI passes and I'll do the final signoff on header naming.

maya: Thanks all 1 leaving a merge checklist comment in the PR.
